recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: nations quietly competing on invisible surveillance scoreboards
premium aluminum laptops climbing in price
tremors rattling Venezuela in a moment of uncertainty
continental heat drifting east, mercury on highest alert
summer fog sitting low over San Francisco bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap glowing nodes in time with a pulsing melodic house beat bleeding through SF summer fog; each perfect streak thins the mist to reveal the skyline.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: clearing fog layers in 30 seconds feels like the beat finally breaking through overcast
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, ghost notes and off-beat decoys appear as fog thickens on misses
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe skyline through gray mist

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw diversion channels across a cracked tile floor to reroute tremor ripples before they reach fragile structures.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: draw path to redirect rolling shockwaves
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one clean reroute saves an entire city block in under a minute
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: multiple fault lines activate, ripples speed up and split into forks

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Swipe between lanes to sort drifting heat zones eastward, matching temperature hues as a continental heatwave migrates across the screen.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing mismatched zones feels like easing a pressure front off the map
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: lanes multiply, hues blur together, sorting window shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor weather radar bleeding warm into cool

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick orbiting probe satellites to scoop data fragments while dodging overlapping surveillance sweep arcs that widen each pass.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: flick to launch orbit, hold to brake
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: chaining scoops without triggering a full sweep scan
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: sweep arcs overlap faster and probe orbit decays unless you re-flick
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: cold minimal satellite UI with scan-line interference
